description: No AiNxt Platform. The ainxt CLI talks directly to a model you configure yourself (Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Recommended unless your team runs the AiNxt Platform.
notes: gatewayUrl is intentionally empty. With no gateway configured, the ainxt CLI reads its model from ~/.ainxt/config.toml ([model.*] entries) or from AINXT_API_KEY / `ainxt login` against your own provider.
model is intentionally empty: set a default in ~/.ainxt/config.toml ([models].default), or pick one from the model picker once connected.
Use the Connect button to save an API key — no gateway URL is needed for this profile.
Switch to the "Self-hosted gateway" profile only if your organisation runs the AiNxt Platform (ainxt-enterprise).
